name: Kore Potash plc
summary: Kore Potash plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration and development of potash minerals in the Republic of Congo. It holds interest in the Sintoukola Potash project that includes the Kola sylvinite and carnallite deposits, as well as DX sylvinite and Dougou carnallite deposits located in Pointe Noire. Kore Potash plc was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
